name: etherpk-stack
title: EtherPK Stack
description: In the mould of Hugo's Stack: a card-based blog with a left sidebar of site identity and menu, article cards in the middle, and widgets (search, contents, archive, pages) on the right.

includes.name: head
includes.description: Extra markup inside <head>: analytics, fonts, meta tags. Raw HTML in the page body.

includes.name: logo
includes.description: The avatar above the site title in the sidebar: an image or inline SVG. Replaces the EtherPK icon.

includes.name: header
includes.description: The left sidebar's identity block (avatar, title, description). Replaces the theme's; the menu stays.

includes.name: before-content
includes.description: Rendered above every page's content: a banner, a notice.

includes.name: after-content
includes.description: Rendered below every page's content, above the linked references: an author bio, a comments widget.

includes.name: footer
includes.description: The footer under the article column.

includes.name: scripts
includes.description: Scripts before </body>, added after the theme's own (search, the theme toggle): analytics, a widget. Raw HTML in the page body.

includes.name: styles
includes.description: CSS appended after the theme's stylesheet: the page's first css fence.
